issue.title: [NGXS]: @ngxs/router-plugin not working with Ivy

repository.name: ngcc-validation
repository.description: Angular Ivy library compatibility validation project

body: I have the same problem with --enable-ivy on, NgxsRouterPluginModule does not work, gives me the same error, rests are okay

@alxhub @AndrewKushnir 

FYI I've updated Angular version to the `9.0.0-next.5` in this [repro](https://github.com/arturovt/ivy-ngxs-repro).

It's built without errors but still there is a runtime error `Can't resolve all parameters for RouterState: (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?).`.

When running `ivy-ngcc`, it fails when `Compiling @ngxs/router-plugin : main as umd` with:
> Value at position 0 in the NgModule.imports of NgxsRouterPluginModule is not a reference: [object Object]

Also I've noticed that it fails with `Can't resolve all parameters for RouterState` because there is no `ngInjectableDef` and if I add it manually, then in works:
```ts
RouterState.ngInjectableDef = defineInjectable({
  factory: () =>
    new RouterState(
      inject(Store),
      inject(Router),
      inject(<any>RouterStateSerializer),
      inject(NgZone),
      inject(<any>UrlSerializer),
      inject(<any>LocationStrategy),
      inject(Location)
    ),
  token: RouterState,
  providedIn: 'root'
});
```

Hi @arturovt,

Thanks for additional information. I've looked at the code and it seems like the issue appears because there is insufficient type information provided when you use `ModuleWithProviders` type, for example [here](https://github.com/ngxs/store/blob/9cce563ce3ddf3a294a97887f9ac95d32e07ef47/packages/store/src/module.ts#L80), it should be `ModuleWithProviders<NgxsModule>`, see docs for `ModuleWithProviders` type [here](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/packages/core/src/metadata/ng_module.ts#L86-L87).

Please try to update all usages of the `ModuleWithProviders` type in your project, try to compile it with Ivy again and let us know if that resolved the problem. Note: this change is also compatible with View Engine.

Thank you.
